title: An aqueous lithium polyacrylic acid binder enables sulfur distribution and high active material loading to enhance Li–S battery performance
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, 5,518-527
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00380F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dharmapura H. K. Murthy, Pranjalee Ghosh, Syeda Reha Khadri, Manu U. M. Patel
Commonly used Li–S cathode binders need harmful, non-green solvents, which negatively impact scalability and the environment. We developed LiPAA binder that can be processed with water while improving the battery performance and stability.
